title: ARS Ingest Agent — Input (QC precondition gate + polymorphic production source)
description: Validates the v1.0 input of the Ingest Agent (Agent #8 of 17 — the first post-production agent, the 8th defense-in-depth firewall pass, the mode-convergence seam). Authored Day 54 (Fri Jun 12 2026) from SPEC §2 Inputs (Day 48 outline) + §10 Field Map (Day 51 partial 1) + §10.4 schema authoring note + §10.5 ingestion-by-mode matrix + §16 metadata block (Day 52 partial 2). TWO defining input characteristics: (1) the QC precondition gate — Ingest reads preflight_report FIRST and never ingests an unvetted reel (Hard Rule #3 / Decision #4); (2) the polymorphic production source — Mode B/C consume replicated_shots (Mode B adds an optional rendered_shots forensic cross-ref), Mode A consumes a footage_upload_manifest. Exactly one source shape is present (top-level oneOf split keyed by metadata.production_mode). Ingest's verdict logic is mode-AGNOSTIC (§4); production_mode drives source selection + take-substitution + reshoot reachability only (§10.5 matrix). Like every prior ARS schema this is single-file (no external $ref resolution): deep replicated_shots / rendered_shots internals are validated by their own LOCKED producer schemas (Style Replication output.schema.json / AI Video Gen output.schema.json — read-only) and left permissive here to avoid canon drift; this schema constrains the ingest-relevant envelope + the fields the 11-check self-QC adjudicates. parent_chain inbound = QC Pre-flight's 6-tuple, HELD ADDITIVELY (minItems 5 accepts the 5-tuple pre-ratification canon; maxItems 6 accepts the QC 6-tuple extension preview; items false). Runtime halts (NOT schema rejections): inbound errorEnvelope on the consumed branch => upstream_not_success; preflight verdict != pass with no Lever-3 sign-off => upstream_qc_not_passed; malformed parent_chain => manifest_lineage_failure. TODO@cross-spec-3.9-ratification: when the n-tuple amendment ratifies AND the QC Pre-flight 6-tuple LOCKs, flip inbound to minItems 6 (exact-6). The 6-tuple is NOT auto-advanced this run (Decision D6 — doubly-deferred).

preflight_report.description: §2 QC precondition gate (Hard Rule #3 / Decision #4 / Step 1). Ingest reads this FIRST. The runtime gate: verdict_observed == 'pass' OR lever3_signoff_present == true is REQUIRED to proceed; otherwise the agent halts with upstream_qc_not_passed (a runtime halt, not a schema rejection — a non-pass preflight is a valid object, an invalid ingest). Deep preflight internals are owned by the QC Pre-flight output.schema.json (read-only); only the gate-relevant envelope is constrained here. Ingest reads the verdict, NEVER the per-point brand_voice adjudication (§10.3 no-touch — that is QC Pre-flight's jurisdiction).

verdict.description: The upstream QC verdict (QC Pre-flight emits pass|fail|reshoot|hold). Ingest proceeds ONLY on 'pass' OR an attached Lever-3 sign-off; any other value with no sign-off => upstream_qc_not_passed at runtime.

lever3_signoff.description: OPTIONAL human Lever-3 sign-off — the ONLY bypass of the QC-pass precondition (Decision #4). Presence with signoff_present:true permits ingest of a non-pass reel. Absent / null on the normal pass path.

production_plan.description: Denormalized ProdCoord output carried for the declared-spec targets + platform_variants + brand-asset pulls. platform_variants[] is the aspect/frame-rate/resolution/container target set adjudicated by the spec_check (Check #5, §10 spec_check rows). Deep internals owned by the ProdCoord schema (read-only).

platform_variants.description: Non-empty target set. Each variant carries the declared aspect/duration/caption-burn target the spec_check adjudicates against the DECLARED asset metadata (byte_probe_performed:false — no decode).

assets_pulled.description: OPTIONAL — brand-asset filename list (logo, lower-third templates) named by the plan. Ingest confirms firewall-clean filenames (Check #4 / asset_firewall_pass_8) but does NOT fetch (§10.1 row).

music_bed.description: OPTIONAL — production-plan music reference (Mode B/C). URI-integrity checked (Check #3). Platform-relative ars:// (Hard Rule #8).

storyboard_ref.description: §10 coverage_check basis. shots_required == storyboard_ref.total_shots (Check #6 — no phantom coverage). Carried denormalized so the coverage invariant is self-contained at the asset layer.

replicated_shots.description: MODE B/C source (§2 / §10.5). Style Replication output.schema.json successReplicatedShots branch — the produced asset set. Deep internals enforced by the LOCKED producer schema (read-only); ingest-relevant per-shot fields constrained here. Mode C = single-source; Mode B may additionally carry the optional rendered_shots forensic cross-ref. An inbound errorEnvelope here is a runtime halt (upstream_not_success), NOT a schema-valid input.

rendered_shots.description: OPTIONAL — Mode B forensic cross-ref only (§10.5). AI Video Gen output.schema.json successRenderedShots branch. Permitted ONLY alongside replicated_shots (Mode B). Absent in Mode A (footage_upload_manifest branch) and Mode C (single-source).

footage_upload_manifest.description: MODE A source (§2 / §10.5) — videographer-uploaded live footage. Carries per-shot clips with take numbers (the take-substitution ladder basis, Hard Rule #8), an audio file list, and an optional music bed. This is the ONLY source shape from which verdict 'reshoot' is reachable (live footage can be re-shot; AI output is re-genned — Decision #3, Mode-A-exclusive).

clips.description: Per-shot live-footage clips. Multiple takes per shot_ref are expected; the highest-numbered take satisfying the declared spec is selected (take-substitution ladder). Ladder-exhausted with no covering take => missing_shot_coverage => reshoot.

audio.description: Flat audio asset list (§10.1 normalization row). Sync adjudication lives in spec_check, not here.

music_bed.description: OPTIONAL — single music-bed URI. URI-integrity checked (Check #3).

oneOf.title: Mode B/C source branch
oneOf.description: replicated_shots present; footage_upload_manifest forbidden. rendered_shots permitted (Mode B forensic cross-ref) or absent (Mode C single-source).

oneOf.title: Mode A source branch
oneOf.description: footage_upload_manifest present; replicated_shots AND rendered_shots forbidden (those are the AI-production source shapes).

preflightReportId.description: QC Pre-flight's emitted identity (§ QC output) + the 6th inbound parent_chain element. v1.0: ^preflight-REINVENTED-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN$ (multi-brand v1.1+ widens the prefix).

platformVariant.description: A target platform render spec. The spec_check adjudicates declared aspect / frame-rate / resolution / container-codec / duration against these targets (declared metadata only — no decode).

replicatedShotConsumed.description: Ingest-relevant projection of a Style Replication replicated_shot (Mode B/C). Deep internals validated by the producer schema (read-only). Ingest reads shot_ref (coverage census), asset_uri (ars:// platform-relative — Hard Rule #8 / Check #3), declared_spec.duration_sec (spec_check duration-fold — Decision #14), and the upstream qc_pre_flags floor.

asset_uri.description: Platform-relative ars:// URI (Hard Rule #8 — NO absolute URLs). A non-relative or dangling URI => asset_uri_integrity_failure (Check #3).

renderedShotConsumed.description: Ingest-relevant projection of an AI Video Gen rendered_shot (Mode B forensic cross-ref). Optional lineage context; deep internals owned by the AI Video Gen schema (read-only).

footageClip.description: A Mode A live-footage clip. take numbers drive the take-substitution ladder (Hard Rule #8): the highest take satisfying the declared spec is selected; ladder-exhausted => reshoot.

take.description: Take number. Substitution prefers the highest take meeting the declared spec.

qcPreFlagsArray.description: Cross-SPEC §3.4 minItems-4 floor + §3.7 snake_case predicate shape. Consumed read-only by Ingest (QC Pre-flight already adjudicated the floor); Ingest appends its own >=4 predicates downstream without modifying this surface (§10.3).

sessionId.description: Inbound session identifier. Accepts Cross-SPEC §3.9 UUID(-v7) canon OR the established ars-/sess- prefixed forms (additive, backward-compatible — does not false-reject existing pipeline session ids). Single combined pattern avoids oneOf/format ambiguity (format is annotation-only under Draft 2020-12 default assertion behavior).

inboundParentChainHeld.description: Inbound lineage = QC Pre-flight's 6-tuple, HELD ADDITIVELY. positions 0-4 inherit Style Replication's 5-tuple canon verbatim (ARS-2026-05-22-Style-Replication-output.schema.json); position 5 = the QC Pre-flight extension (preflight_report_id). minItems 5 ACCEPTS the 5-tuple pre-ratification canon; maxItems 6 ACCEPTS the QC 6-tuple extension preview; items false. REJECTS a 4-tuple. Ingest validates a well-formed inbound chain (Step 2); malformed => manifest_lineage_failure at runtime. Ingest appends its own asset_manifest_id at position 6 on OUTPUT (see output.schema.json — 7-tuple, also held additively). TODO@cross-spec-3.9-ratification: flip to minItems 6 (exact-6) when the n-tuple amendment ratifies AND the QC Pre-flight 6-tuple LOCKs (Decision D6 — doubly-deferred, NOT auto-advanced this run).

inboundMetadataBlock.description: Cross-SPEC §3.9 inbound metadata carried from QC Pre-flight. Ingest reads tier / production_mode (source-branch selection + reshoot reachability — NOT verdict forking) / lever_state / parent_chain (6-tuple, held) / brand_id for context + the 8th-pass tier-mode re-validation (Check #4). production_mode is the polymorphic-source discriminator (A => footage_upload_manifest; B/C => replicated_shots).

tier.description: Universal — ALL 4 tiers traverse Ingest at ~$0 (§4 / Decision #2). Asset readiness is not a tier feature.
